Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SI_Configurations" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "x_SICf"

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SICf"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SDSI As NotesDocument Dim na As NotesAgent Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
' Extraire le document des paramètres ' ----------------------------------- Set na = gns_A.CurrentAgent If na.ParameterDocID = "" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Erreur 1: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ").", 1, 0, False) Print "Erreur: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ")." Goto EnregistrerLog End If
' Extraire le document de configuration SDS Set nd_SDSI = gndb_A.GetDocumentByID(na.ParameterDocID) If nd_SDSI Is Nothing Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Erreur 2: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ").", 1, 0, False) Print "Erreur: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ")." Goto EnregistrerLog End If
Set ni = nd_SDSI.GetFirstItem("Inst_Logiciels") If ni.Contains("60") Then ' Print "Initialize: SDS (60)" ' Début du traitement de l'agent ' ------------------------------ If Not A_TraiterSDS(nd_SDSI) Then 'Une erreur s'est produite pendant la mise de la configuration SDS. If nd_SDSI.HasItem("Temp_SendTo") Then Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_SDSI, "A_SICf:60", "FR", xVar(nd_SDSI, "Temp_SendTo", ""), "", "", 0, False) nd_Courriel.Principal = gndb_A.Title Call nd_Courriel.Send(True,False) End If End If End If
If ni.Contains("65") Then ' Print "Initialize: SDS Merlin (65)" If Not A_TraiterMerlin(nd_SDSI) Then 'Une erreur s'est produite pendant la mise de la configuration SDS-Merlin. If nd_SDSI.HasItem("Temp_SendTo") Then Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_SDSI, "A_SICf:65", "FR", xVar(nd_SDSI, "Temp_SendTo", ""), "", "", 0, False) nd_Courriel.Principal = gndb_A.Title Call nd_Courriel.Send(True,False) End If End If End If Exit Sub
EnregistrerLog: Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations
If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function A_TraiterSDS(pnd_Inst_A As NotesDocument) As Boolean '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Cette fonction permet de faire un mise a jour de la version et date d'installation du ' document SDS dans SI Configurations. ' Met aussi à jour les autres clients qui partagent le serveur. ' Paramètres : pnd_Inst_A : Le document d'installation de SDS Installations. '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_SDS As NotesView Dim ndc_SDS As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_VersionSDS As String
Dim v_NoServeur As String Dim v_NoClientFmt_Inst As String
Dim v_traiter As Boolean Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations
A_TraiterSDS = False v_NoClientFmt_Inst = xVar(pnd_Inst_A,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") Set nd_SDS = xSICf_xndSDS(v_NoClientFmt_Inst, True) ' Si pas de SDS créer un nouveau If nd_SDS Is Nothing Then Set nd_SDS = SICf_CreerConfigurationSDS(v_NoClientFmt_Inst) End If
' Créer la collection vide Set ndc_SDS = gndb_xSICf.CreateDocumentCollection
' Ajoute nd_SDS dans la collection Call ndc_SDS.Adddocument(nd_SDS) Set nd_Serv = Nothing If SICf_ndServSDS(v_NoClientFmt_Inst, "", Nothing, nd_Serv, nd_SDS) Then If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then v_NoServeur = xVar(nd_Serv, "CONF_NOCONFIGURATION", "") Set nv_SDS = gndb_xSICf.GetView("V_SDS11") Set ndc_SDS = nv_SDS.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoServeur, True) End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_SDS.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_SDS = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_SDS.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Version SDS v_VersionSDS = xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_60_Version", "") If xVar(nd_SDS,"SDS_VersionSDS", "") <> v_VersionSDS Then nd_SDS.SDS_VersionSDS = v_VersionSDS nd_SDS.SDS_VersionSDS = v_VersionSDS
' Date de mise à jour Select Case xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") Case "I", "N": Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_SDS, "SDS_DateDernMAJ", xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_DateInstallation", "")) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Case "M", "U": Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_SDS, "SDS_DateDernMAJ", xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_60_DateConversion", "")) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End Select
Call nd_SDS.Save(True,False)
v_traiter = True End If
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 Loop
If v_traiter Then A_TraiterSDS = True End If
Print "A_SICf : Fin SDS " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_TraiterMerlin(pnd_Inst_A As NotesDocument) As Boolean '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Cette fonction permet de faire un mise a jour de la version et date d'installation du ' document Merlin dans SI Configurations. ' Ne met pas à jour les autres clients qui partagent le serveur. ' Paramètres : pnd_Inst_A : Le document d'installation de SDS Installations. '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Merlin As NotesView Dim ndc_Merlin As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Merlin As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_DescVersionMerlin As String
Dim v_NoServeur As String Dim v_NoClientFmt_Inst As String Dim v_InstA_65_Version As String
Dim v_traiter As Boolean Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
A_TraiterMerlin = False v_NoClientFmt_Inst = xVar(pnd_Inst_A,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") Set nd_Merlin = xSICf_xndMerl(v_NoClientFmt_Inst, True) ' Si pas de SDS Merlin créer un nouveau If nd_Merlin Is Nothing Then Set nd_Merlin = SICf_CreerConfigurationMerlin(v_NoClientFmt_Inst) End If
%REM Ne met pas à jour les autres clients qui partagent le serveur. PBE ' Créer la collection vide Set ndc_Merlin = gndb_xSICf.CreateDocumentCollection
' Ajoute nd_Merlin dans la collection Call ndc_Merlin.Adddocument(nd_Merlin) Set nd_Serv = Nothing If SICf_ndServMerl(v_NoClientFmt_Inst, "", Nothing, nd_Serv, nd_Merlin) Then If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then v_NoServeur = xVar(nd_Serv, "CONF_NOCONFIGURATION", "") Set nv_Merlin = gndb_xSICf.GetView("V_Merl11") Set ndc_Merlin = nv_Merlin.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoServeur, True) End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Merlin.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Merlin = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Merlin.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) %END REM
' Version Merlin v_InstA_65_Version = xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_65_Version", "") If xVar(nd_Merlin, "Merl_VersionMerlin", "") <> v_InstA_65_Version Then nd_Merlin.Merl_VersionMerlin = v_InstA_65_Version v_DescVersionMerlin = xGDK_xDescTabl(v_InstA_65_Version, "Merl_Versions" & xLangue, True) nd_Merlin.Merl_DescVersionMerlin = v_DescVersionMerlin nd_Merlin.Conf_Informations = v_DescVersionMerlin
' Date de mise à jour Select Case xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") Case "I", "N": Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_Merlin, "Merl_DateDernMAJ", xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_DateInstallation", "")) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Case "M", "U" : Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_Merlin, "Merl_DateDernMAJ", xVar(pnd_Inst_A, "Inst_65_DateConversion", "")) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End Select
Call nd_Merlin.Save(True, False) v_traiter = True End If
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 %REM Loop %END REM
If v_traiter Then A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
Print "A_SICf : Fin SDS Merlin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_MajAgenda(pnd_Inte As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_NoIntervenant As String Dim ndb_Mail As NotesDatabase Dim nv_Evnt As NotesView Dim nd_Evnt As NotesDocument
' L'agenda est désormail dans Outlook A_MajAgenda = True Exit function
A_MajAgenda = False
v_Date = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_DateInterventionFin", "") If Not Isdate(v_Date) Then v_Date = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_DateInterventionDebut", "") End If If v_Date < Today Then Exit Function End If
' Mettre à jour l'agenda de l'utilisateur v_NoIntervenant = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervenant", "") Set ndb_Mail = SDSNM_ndbCourriel(v_NoIntervenant, nv_Evnt) If Not (nv_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Select Case xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_Statut", "") Case "90" : If xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_TypeInterventionUnite", "") = "1" Then ' Heures '<EB> 53984 ancien code Call SDSNM_CreerReunion(pnd_Inte, ndb_Mail, nv_Evnt) Else '<EB> 53984 ancien code Call SDSNM_CreerEvenement(pnd_Inte, ndb_Mail, nv_Evnt) End If pnd_Inte.Inte_AgendaMaj = "1" A_MajAgenda = True
' Intervention annulée - Supprimer ;'évenement de l'agenda Case "99" : Set nd_Evnt = nv_Evnt.GetDocumentByKey("SDSI;" & xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervention", ""), True) If Not (nd_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Call nd_Evnt.Remove(True) End If pnd_Inte.Inte_AgendaMaj = "" A_MajAgenda = True End Select End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A , GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Inst As NotesDocument, pnd_Inte As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String
A_EnvoyerCourriel = False
Call pnd_Inte.CopyAllItems(pnd_Inst, True)
v_Statut = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_Statut", "") If SICT_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Inst, "A_WFIn_" & v_Statut,"FR", "", "", "", "", 0, False) Then A_EnvoyerCourriel = True
' Modifiée - changer le statut pour 90 - Valide If v_Statut = "70" Then Call Inte_AssignerStatut(pnd_Inte, "90", "") End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A , GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub A_TraiterInterventions On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim v_TypeInstallation As String
Set nv = gndb_A.GetView("V_Inte30") Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetNextDocument( nd_Suivant) v_Maj = False
' Envoyer le courriel de workflow Set nd_Inst = xSDSI_xndInst(xVar(nd, "Inte_NoInstallation", ""), True) If nd_Inst Is Nothing Then Print "Erreur : Installation non trouvée. (" & xVar(nd, "Inte_NoInstallation", "") & ")" Else v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd, "Inte_TypeIntervention", "")
' Envoyer un courriel à l'intervenant If xVar(nd, "Inte_EnvoyerCourriel", "") = "1" Then If xSDSI_xContainsTypI(v_TypeInstallation, "TypI_IntervenantOptions", "WF", True) Then Call A_EnvoyerCourriel(nd_Inst, nd) nd.Inte_EnvoyerCourriel = "" v_Maj = True End If End If
' Mettre à jour l'agenda de l'intervenant If xVar(nd, "Inte_MajAgenda", "") = "1" Then If xSDSI_xContainsTypI(v_TypeInstallation, "TypI_IntervenantOptions", "AG", True) Then Call A_MajAgenda(nd) nd.Inte_MajAgenda = "" v_Maj = True End If End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.Save(True, False) End If End If Loop
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A , GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Dim gns_SDSNM As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSNM As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SDSNM = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSNM = "SDS_NotesMail"

Function SDSNM_CreerReunion(pnd_Inte As NotesDocument, pndb_Mail As NotesDatabase, pnv_Evnt As NotesView) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Evnt As NotesDocument Dim v_Objet As String Dim v_NoClient As String Dim v_Lieu As String
SDSNM_CreerReunion = False Call SDSNM_Initialisations Set nd_Evnt = Nothing
' Extraire l'évenement de l'agenda Set ndc = pnv_Evnt.GetAlldocumentsByKey("SDSI;" & xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervention", ""), True) If ndc.Count > 1 Then Call ndc.RemoveAll(True) Elseif ndc.Count = 1Then Set nd_Evnt = ndc.GetFirstDocument End If
' L'évènement existe dans la base de courriel - le supprimer If Not (nd_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Call nd_Evnt.remove(True) Set nd_Evnt = Nothing End If
' L'évènement n'existe pas dans la base de courriel - le créer v_Objet = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_TypeInterventionDescFR", "") & " " & _ xSDSI_xVarInst(xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoInstallation", ""), "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) & " (" & gndb_SDSNM.Title & ")"
v_NoClient = xSDSI_xVarInst(xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoInstallation", ""), "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) v_Lieu = xSICl_xVarClie(v_NoClient, "Clie_ClientVille", "", True) If v_Lieu <> "" Then v_Lieu = v_Lieu & ", " & xSICl_xVarClie(v_NoClient, "Clie_ClientProvince", "", True) End If Set nd_Evnt = SINM_AjouterReunion(pndb_Mail, xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_DateInterventionDebut", ""), _ xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_HeureInterventionDebut", ""), xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NbHeures", ""), v_Objet, v_Lieu, _ gndb_SDSNM.Title, xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_IdIntervenant", ""), "SIEv_Reference", _ "SDSI;" & xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervention", ""))
If nd_Evnt Is Nothing Then Print "Erreur lors de l'ajout d'une réunion dans la base de documents de " & pndb_Mail.Title Else SDSNM_CreerReunion = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSNM, gc_Element_SDSNM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSNM_CreerEvenement(pnd_Inte As NotesDocument, pndb_Mail As NotesDatabase, pnv_Evnt As NotesView) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Evnt As NotesDocument Dim v_Objet As String Dim v_NoClient As String Dim v_Lieu As String
SDSNM_CreerEvenement = False Call SDSNM_Initialisations Set nd_Evnt = Nothing
' Extraire l'évenement de l'agenda Set ndc = pnv_Evnt.GetAlldocumentsByKey("SDSI;" & xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervention", ""), True) If ndc.Count > 1 Then Call ndc.RemoveAll(True) Elseif ndc.Count = 1Then Set nd_Evnt = ndc.GetFirstDocument End If
' L'évènement existe dans la base de courriel - le supprimer If Not (nd_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Call nd_Evnt.remove(True) Set nd_Evnt = Nothing End If
' L'évènement n'existe pas dans la base de courriel - le créer v_Objet = xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_TypeInterventionDescFR", "") & " " & _ xSDSI_xVarInst(xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoInstallation", ""), "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) & " (" & gndb_SDSNM.Title & ")"
v_NoClient = xSDSI_xVarInst(xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoInstallation", ""), "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) v_Lieu = xSICl_xVarClie(v_NoClient, "Clie_ClientVille", "", True) If v_Lieu <> "" Then v_Lieu = v_Lieu & ", " & xSICl_xVarClie(v_NoClient, "Clie_ClientProvince", "", True) End If Set nd_Evnt = SINM_AjouterEvenement(pndb_Mail, xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_DateInterventionDebut", ""), _ xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_DateInterventionFin", ""), 0, v_Objet, v_Lieu, gndb_SDSNM.Title, "SIEv_Reference", _ "SDSI;" & xVar(pnd_Inte, "Inte_NoIntervention", ""))
If nd_Evnt Is Nothing Then Print "Erreur lors de l'ajout d'un évènement dans la base de documents de " & pndb_Mail.Title Else SDSNM_CreerEvenement = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSNM, gc_Element_SDSNM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SDSNM_Initialisations If gns_SDSNM Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSNM = New NotesSession Set gndb_SDSNM = gns_SDSNM.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Function SDSNM_ndbCourriel(p_NoEmploye As String, pnv As NotesView) As NotesDatabase On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SIEm As NotesDocument Dim v_EmployeActif As Boolean Dim v_IdUtilisateur As String Dim v_NoErreur As Integer Dim v_Message As String
Set pnv = Nothing
Set nd_SIEm = xSIEm_xndEmpl(p_NoEmploye, True) If Not (nd_SIEm Is Nothing) Then v_EmployeActif = (xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_Activite", "") = "A" Or xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_Activite", "") = "9") If v_EmployeActif Then If xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_PasDeNotesId", "") = "1" Then Set SDSNM_ndbCourriel = Nothing Else v_IdUtilisateur = xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_NotesId", "") If v_IdUtilisateur <> "" Then Set SDSNM_ndbCourriel = SINM_ndbCourriel(v_IdUtilisateur) If SDSNM_ndbCourriel Is Nothing Then v_NoErreur = 1 Elseif Not SDSNM_ndbCourriel.IsOpen Then v_NoErreur = 2 End If Else v_NoErreur = 3 End If End If Else v_NoErreur = 4 End If Else v_NoErreur = 5 End If
' Extraire la vue des évènements If v_NoErreur > 0 Then v_Message = "SDSI: La base de courriel de " & xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_NomEmploye", "") & " n'est pas disponible. (" & Cstr(v_NoErreur) & ")" Else Set pnv = SDSNM_ndbCourriel.GetView("V_SIEv") If pnv Is Nothing Then v_NoErreur = 9 v_Message = "SDSI: La base de courriel de " & xVar(nd_SIEm, "Empl_NomEmploye", "") & " n'est pas à jour. (" & Cstr(v_NoErreur) & ")" Set SDSNM_ndbCourriel = Nothing End If End If
If v_NoErreur > 0 Then Print v_Message If v_NoErreur <> 4 Then ' Salarié inactif - pas de message. ' Call SIGE_EnvoyerErreur("dpNotes_Admin", "", v_Message) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSNM, gc_Element_SDSNM, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SDSI" Use "x_Tabl"

Dim gns_Suiv As NotesSession Dim gndb_Suiv As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_Suiv = "SL" Const gc_Element_Suiv = "SDS_Suivi"

Function Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilises(p_NoInstallation As String, p_TypeIntervention As String, p_Unite As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NbJours As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim a1 As Variant Dim a2 As Variant Dim nv As NotesView Dim nvec As NotesViewEntryCollection Dim nve As NotesViewEntry Dim nd_TypI As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_AfficherVue As String
' Initialisations Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilises = False Call Suiv_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de suivi Set nd = xSDSI_xndSuiv(p_NoInstallation, True) If nd Is Nothing Then Set nd_Inst = xSDSI_xndInst(p_NoInstallation, True)
Set nd = New NotesDocument(nd_Inst.Parentdatabase) nd.Form = "F_Suiv" nd.Cle = p_NoInstallation nd.Suiv_NoInstallation = p_NoInstallation
nd.Suiv_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "")
' Faire du document de Suivi une réponse du document d'Installation Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Inst) End If
' Vérifier l'information du client If xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNoFmt", "") <> xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNoFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If If xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNomInterne", "") <> xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomInterne = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) v_Maj = True End If a1 = xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNomFmt", "") a2 = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) If Isarray(a1) <> Isarray(a2) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True Elseif Isarray(a1) Then If Implode(a1, ";") <> Implode(a2, ";") Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If Elseif a1 <> a2 Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If
' Modifier le nombre de jours utilisés If p_TypeIntervention = "" Then Set nv = gndb_Suiv.GetView("V_TypI20") Set nvec = nv.AllEntries Set nve = nvec.GetFirstEntry Do Until nve Is Nothing Set nd_TypI = nve.Document Set ni = nd_TypI.GetFirstItem("TypI_DureeOptions") If ni.Contains("SV") Then If Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilisesType(nd, xVar(nd_TypI, "TypI_Code", ""), xVar(nd_TypI, "TypI_DureeUnite", ""), v_AfficherVue) Then v_Maj = True End If End If
Set nve = nvec.GetNextEntry(nve) Loop
If v_AfficherVue <> xVar(nd, "Suiv_AfficherVue", "") Then nd.Suiv_AfficherVue = v_AfficherVue v_Maj = True End If Else v_Maj = Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilisesType(nd, p_TypeIntervention, p_Unite, v_AfficherVue) Or v_Maj If v_AfficherVue = "1" And xVar(nd, "Suiv_AfficherVue", "") <> "1" Then nd.Suiv_AfficherVue = v_AfficherVue v_Maj = True End If End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.Save(True, False) Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilises = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Suiv, gc_Element_Suiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function Suivi_CalculerGratuites(p_NoInstallation As String, p_TypeIntervention As String, _ p_Unite As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NbGratuites As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim a1 As Variant Dim a2 As Variant Dim nv As NotesView Dim nvec As NotesViewEntryCollection Dim nve As NotesViewEntry Dim nd_TypI As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisations Suivi_CalculerGratuites = False Call Suiv_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de suivi Set nd = xSDSI_xndSuiv(p_NoInstallation, True) If nd Is Nothing Then Set nd_Inst = xSDSI_xndInst(p_NoInstallation, True)
Set nd = New NotesDocument(nd_Inst.Parentdatabase) nd.Form = "F_Suiv" nd.Cle = p_NoInstallation nd.Suiv_NoInstallation = p_NoInstallation
nd.Suiv_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "")
' Faire du document de Suivi une réponse du document d'Installation Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Inst) End If
' Vérifier l'information du client If xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNoFmt", "") <> xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNoFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If If xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNomInterne", "") <> xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomInterne = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "", True) v_Maj = True End If a1 = xVar(nd, "Suiv_ClientNomFmt", "") a2 = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) If Isarray(a1) <> Isarray(a2) Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True Elseif Isarray(a1) Then If Implode(a1, ";") <> Implode(a2, ";") Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If Elseif a1 <> a2 Then nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xSDSI_xVarInst(p_NoInstallation, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "", True) v_Maj = True End If
' Modifier le nombre de jours utilisés If p_TypeIntervention = "" Then Set nv = gndb_Suiv.GetView("V_TypI20") Set nvec = nv.AllEntries Set nve = nvec.GetFirstEntry Do Until nve Is Nothing Set nd_TypI = nve.Document Set ni = nd_TypI.GetFirstItem("TypI_DureeOptions") If ni.Contains("SV") Then If Suivi_CalculerGratuitesType(nd, xVar(nd_TypI, "TypI_Code", ""), xVar(nd_TypI, "TypI_DureeUnite", "")) Then v_Maj = True End If End If
Set nve = nvec.GetNextEntry(nve) Loop Else v_Maj = Suivi_CalculerGratuitesType(nd, p_TypeIntervention, p_Unite) Or v_Maj End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.Save(True, False) Suivi_CalculerGratuites = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Suiv, gc_Element_Suiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub Suiv_Initialisations If gns_Suiv Is Nothing Then Set gns_Suiv = New NotesSession Set gndb_Suiv = gns_Suiv.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Function Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilisesType(pnd As NotesDocument, p_TypeIntervention As String, p_Unite As String, _ p_AfficherVue As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Colonne As Integer Dim s As String Dim v_NbJours As Variant
Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilisesType = False
If p_Unite = "1" Then v_Colonne = 4 ElseIf p_Unite = "2" Then v_Colonne = 7 Else v_Colonne = 3 End If s = |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Inte23"; "| & xVar(pnd, "Suiv_NoInstallation", "") & |;| & _ p_TypeIntervention & |"; | & Cstr(v_Colonne) & |); 0))| v_NbJours = Evaluate(s) If Not Isarray(xVarArray(pnd, "Suiv_JoursUtilises" & p_TypeIntervention)) _ Or v_NbJours(0) <> xVar(pnd, "Suiv_JoursUtilises" & p_TypeIntervention, 0) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("Suiv_JoursUtilises" & p_TypeIntervention, v_NbJours(0)) Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilisesType = True End If
' Déterminer s'il faut l'afficher dans la vue If xVar(pnd, "Suiv_JoursUtilises" & p_TypeIntervention, 0) < xVar(pnd, "Suiv_JoursVendus" & p_TypeIntervention, 0) Then p_AfficherVue = "1" End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Suiv, gc_Element_Suiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function Suivi_CalculerGratuitesType(pnd As NotesDocument, p_TypeIntervention As String, _ p_Unite As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NbGratuites As Variant Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Colonne As integer
' Initialisations Suivi_CalculerGratuitesType = False Call Suiv_Initialisations
If p_Unite = "1" Then v_Colonne = 6 ElseIf p_Unite = "2" Then v_Colonne = 8 Else v_Colonne = 5 End If s = |@Sum(@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Inte23"; "| & xVar(pnd, "Suiv_NoInstallation", "") & |;| & p_TypeIntervention & |"; | & CStr(v_Colonne) & |); 0))| v_NbGratuites = Evaluate(s) If Not Isarray(xVarArray(pnd, "Suiv_NbrGratuit" & p_TypeIntervention)) _ Or v_NbGratuites(0) <> xVar(pnd, "Suiv_NbrGratuit" & p_TypeIntervention, 0) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue("Suiv_NbrGratuit" & p_TypeIntervention, v_NbGratuites(0)) Suivi_CalculerGratuitesType = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Suiv, gc_Element_Suiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function Suiv_ModifierJoursVendus(p_NoInstallation As String, p_TypeIntervention As String, p_NbJours As Double) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Suiv_ModifierJoursVendus = False Call Suiv_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de suivi Set nd = xSDSI_xndSuiv(p_NoInstallation, True) If nd Is Nothing Then Set nd_Inst = xSDSI_xndInst(p_NoInstallation, True)
Set nd = New NotesDocument(nd_Inst.Parentdatabase) nd.Form = "F_Suiv" nd.Cle = p_NoInstallation nd.Suiv_NoInstallation = p_NoInstallation
nd.Suiv_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomInterne", "") nd.Suiv_ClientNomFmt = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_ClientNomFmt", "")
' Faire du document de Suivi une réponse du document d'Installation Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Inst) End If
' Modifier le nombre de jours Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("Suiv_JoursVendus" & p_TypeIntervention, p_NbJours) nd.Suiv_AfficherVue = "1" Call nd.Save(True, False) Suiv_ModifierJoursVendus = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Suiv, gc_Element_Suiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VSuiv_Initialisations On Error Goto GererErreur

Set gnuiws_VSuiv = New Notesuiworkspace End If Exit Sub

Function VSuiv_Queryopendocument(pnuiv_Source As NotesUIview) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nv_Inst As NotesView Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument
' Initialisations VSuiv_Queryopendocument = False Call VSuiv_Initialisations
Set nd = pnuiv_Source.Documents.GetFirstDocument Set nv_Inst = gndb_VSuiv.GetView("V_Inst20") If nv_Inst Is Nothing Then Messagebox "L'installation SDS est introuvable.", 16, "Opération annulée" Else Set nd_Inst = nv_Inst.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd, "Suiv_NoInstallation", ""), True) If nd_Inst Is Nothing Then Messagebox "L'installation SDS est introuvable.", 16, "Opération annulée" Else Call gnuiws_VSuiv.EditDocument(False, nd_Inst, False) End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VSuiv, gc_Element_VSuiv, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Déclarations globales ' ----------------------------------
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIIx = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIIx = "SI_Insertions"

Sub SIIx_AppendItemValue(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurAjouter As Variant Dim a_ValeurActuelle As Variant
' Formatter la valeur à ajouter If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then a_ValeurAjouter = Fulltrim(p_Valeur) If a_ValeurAjouter(0) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter End If Elseif p_Valeur = "" Then ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter Exit Sub Else a_ValeurAjouter = p_Valeur End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'item du document a_ValeurActuelle = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Isarray(a_ValeurActuelle) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, Arrayappend(a_ValeurActuelle, a_ValeurAjouter)) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_ValeurAjouter) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIIx_AppendVar(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Variant, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Variant Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVar = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AppendVarString(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As String, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As String Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarString = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Date As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Date) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.Setanytime
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerDate = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AssignerHeure(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Heure As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Heure) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime If Isdate(p_Heure) Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Heure Call ndt.SetAnyDate
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerHeure = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_MajItem(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, Byval p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIIx_MajItem = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = Lbound(a_ValeurOrig) To Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then For i = Lbound(p_Valeur) To Ubound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next Elseif p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then If Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If Ubound(p_Valeur) <> Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) Then SIIx_MajItem = True Else For i = Lbound(p_Valeur) To Ubound(p_Valeur) If Cstr(p_Valeur(i)) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then SIIx_MajItem = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If Ubound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then SIIx_MajItem = True Elseif Cstr(p_Valeur(0)) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig) Then SIIx_MajItem = True End If End If Elseif Isarray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If Ubound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then SIIx_MajItem = True Elseif Cstr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> Cstr(p_Valeur) Then SIIx_MajItem = True End If Elseif Cstr(p_Valeur) <> Cstr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau SIIx_MajItem = True End If
' Maj le champ If SIIx_MajItem Then If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Elseif p_Date Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AppendVarLong(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Long, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Long Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarLong = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Sub Queryopendocument(Source As Notesuiview, Continue As Variant) Continue = False End Sub
Sub Queryopendocument(Source As Notesuiview, Continue As Variant) Continue = False End Sub
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "x_SICf" Use "x_Tabl"

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As Notesdatabase Dim g_ServeurCSA As String Dim g_FichierCSA As String
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SDSR"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations Call xSICf_Initialisation
' Traitement Call A_TraiterInstallations Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase
g_ServeurCSA = xGDK_xVarNDB("SI CSA", "NDB_Serveur", "", True) g_FichierCSA = xGDK_xVarNDB("SI CSA", "NDB_Fichier", "", True)
End If End Sub

Sub A_TraiterInstallations On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Inst20 As NotesView Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim v_NbrJrCourPaiementRetard As Integer Dim k As Long Dim and_Inst() As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim nd_SDS_SICf As NotesDocument Dim nd_ServParent_SICf As NotesDocument Dim v_InstDateInstallation As Variant Dim v_NbJr As Long Dim v_DateInstallation As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim s As String
' Initialisations Set nv_Inst20 = gndb_A.Getview("V_Inst20") Set nd_Prof = gndb_A.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") v_NbrJrCourPaiementRetard = xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_PaiementRetard",0) k = -1 Redim Preserve and_Inst(1000) As NotesDocument
Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Inst = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
Set ni = nd_Inst.GetFirstItem("Inst_Logiciels") If ni.Contains("60") And xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_Statut", "") < "90"Then s = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") If s = "I" Then
Set nd_SDS_SICf = xSICf_xndSDS(xVar(nd_Inst,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) Set nd_ServParent_SICf = xSICf_xndServ(xVar(nd_SDS_SICf, "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur", ""), 0) If Not (nd_ServParent_SICf Is Nothing) Then If xVar(nd_ServParent_SICf, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") = xVar(nd_SDS_SICf, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") Then If xVar(nd_SDS_SICf, "Conf_Inactif", "") <> "1" Then
' Si installation pas payé If xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_60_Paye", "") <> "1" Then
v_InstDateInstallation = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_DateInstallation", Datenumber(2000, 01, 01)) v_NbJr = (v_InstDateInstallation + Cint(xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_Protection",0))) - Today
If v_NbJr =< v_NbrJrCourPaiementRetard Then k = k +1 Set and_Inst(k) = nd_Inst If k = 253 Then Exit Do ' limit de 255 lignes dans un tableau. Si cela arrive, créer tableau avec premier 255 records. End If End If
End If End If End If End If
End If End If
Loop
'Envoyer liste par courrier If k >= 0 Then Redim Preserve and_Inst(k) As NotesDocument Call A_EnvoyerCourriel(and_Inst) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_EnvoyerCourriel(pndc_Inst() As NotesDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
'--------------------------- ' Pour retourner un courriel '--------------------------- Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim a_Couleurs(1) As Variant Dim a_Entetes(4) As String Dim a_Formules(4) As String Dim a_LargeurColonnes(4) As Double
' Préparer le message Set nd = Nothing Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd, "A_SDSPR", "FR", "", "", "", 0, 0)
' Tableau utilisés pour construire le tableau du courriel a_Formules(0) = |@Text(Inst_ClientNoFmt) | a_Formules(1) = |@Trim(Inst_ClientNom1 +@NewLine+Inst_ClientNom2)| a_Formules(2) =| @Text(Inst_DateInstallation; "S0")| a_Formules(3) =| @Text(Inst_60_DateProtection; "S0")| a_Formules(4) = |"[#noteslink]"|
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_LargeurColonnes(0) = 2 a_LargeurColonnes(1) = 6 a_LargeurColonnes(2) = 3 a_LargeurColonnes(3) = 3 a_LargeurColonnes(4) = 10
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_Couleurs(0) = COLOR_WHITE a_Couleurs(1) = Evaluate("236:231:213")
' Définir les entêtes du tableau a_Entetes(0) = "Numéro" a_Entetes(1) = "Nom" a_Entetes(2) = "Date d'installation" a_Entetes(3) = "Date protection" a_Entetes(4) = "Lien"
' Préparer et envoyer le courriel ' ------------------------------- ' Construire le tableau des installations Call SICT_AjouterTableau(nd_Courriel, "[A_SDSPR]", pndc_Inst, a_Formules, a_Couleurs, a_LargeurColonnes, a_Entetes, 0)
' Envoyer le message nd_Courriel.Principal = gndb_A.Title Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SDSPNR"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations Call xSICf_Initialisation
' Traitement Call A_TraiterInstallations Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Sub A_TraiterInstallations On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Inst20 As NotesView Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_InstDateInstallation As Variant Dim v_NbJr As Long Dim v_DateInstallation As Variant Dim k As Long Dim s As String Dim and_Inst() As NotesDocument
Set nv_Inst20 = gndb_A.Getview("V_Inst20") ' V_Inst20 Set nd_Prof = gndb_A.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") v_NbJr = xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_PaiementNonRecu", 0)
k = -1 Redim Preserve and_Inst(1000) As NotesDocument
Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Inst = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
Set ni = nd_Inst.GetFirstItem("Inst_Logiciels") If ni.Contains("60") Or _ ni.Contains("65") Then s = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") If s = "I" Then If xSICf_xVarSDS(xVar(nd_Inst,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", ""), "Conf_Inactif", "", True) <> "1" And xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_PaiementRecu", "") <> 1 Then v_InstDateInstallation = xVar(nd_Inst, "Inst_DateInstallation", Today)
If Today > (v_InstDateInstallation + v_NbJr) Then k = k +1 Set and_Inst(k) = nd_Inst If k = 250 Then Exit Do ' limit de 255 lignes dans un tableau. Si cela arrive, créer tableau avec premier 255 records. End If End If End If End If End If Loop
'Envoyer liste par courrier If k >= 0 Then Redim Preserve and_Inst(k) As NotesDocument Call A_EnvoyerCourriel(and_Inst) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_EnvoyerCourriel(pand_Inst() As Notesdocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
'--------------------------- ' Pour retourner un courriel '--------------------------- Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim a_Couleurs(1) As Variant Dim a_Entetes(3) As String Dim a_Formules(3) As String Dim a_LargeurColonnes(3) As Double
' Préparer le message Set nd = Nothing Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd, "A_SDSPNR", "FR", "", "", "", 0, False)
' Tableau utilisés pour construire le tableau du courriel a_Formules(0) = |@Text(Inst_ClientNoFmt) | a_Formules(1) = |@Trim(Inst_ClientNom1 +@NewLine+Inst_ClientNom2)| a_Formules(2) =| @Text(Inst_DateInstallation; "S0")| a_Formules(3) = |"[#noteslink]"|
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_LargeurColonnes(0) = 2 a_LargeurColonnes(1) = 6 a_LargeurColonnes(2) = 3 a_LargeurColonnes(3) = 10
' Définir les colonnes du tableau a_Couleurs(0) = COLOR_WHITE a_Couleurs(1) = Evaluate("236:231:213")
' Définir les entêtes du tableau a_Entetes(0) = "Numéro" a_Entetes(1) = "Nom" a_Entetes(2) = "Date d'installation" a_Entetes(3) = "Lien"
' Préparer et envoyer le courriel ' ------------------------------- ' Construire le tableau des installations Call SICT_AjouterTableau(nd_Courriel, "[A_SDSPNR]", pand_Inst, a_Formules, a_Couleurs, a_LargeurColonnes, a_Entetes, 0) ' Envoyer le message nd_Courriel.Principal = gndb_A.Title Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents "SI Représentants". Il faut rechercher la base ' de documents à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SIR" ou "SIR" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SIR" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Rep" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSIRR As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_Repr_xSIRR As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Repr_xSIRR As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_ReprId_xSIRR As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_ReprId_xSIRR As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Equi_xSIRR As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Equi_xSIRR As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Depa_xSIRR As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Depa_xSIRR As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Comm_xSIRR As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document

Function xSIRR_xVarEqui(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.

Function xSIRR_aSuperviseursEqui(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne le ou les superviseurs d'une équipe. Dim a_Superviseurs As Variant

Function xSIRR_xndRepr_Id(ByVal p_NotesId As String, ByVal p_Projeto As String) As NotesDocument ' p_Projeto 0/60/62 optionnel ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
Dim v_Cle As Variant

' Initialiser la vue Call xnv(gndb_xSIRR, gc_NomVueReprId_xSIRR, gnv_ReprId_xSIRR) If Not (gnv_ReprId_xSIRR Is Nothing) Then Call gnv_ReprId_xSIRR.Refresh
If p_Projeto = "" Then Set gnd_Repr_xSIRR = gnv_ReprId_xSIRR.Getdocumentbykey(p_NotesId & ";", False) Else Set gnd_Repr_xSIRR = gnv_ReprId_xSIRR.Getdocumentbykey(p_NotesId & ";" & p_Projeto, True) End If End If
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSIRR_xndRepr_Id = gnd_Repr_xSIRR End Function

Function xSIRR_xndComm(Byval p_NoEquipe As String, Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Province As String) As Notesdocument Dim a_Cle(2) As String Dim nd_Comm As NotesDocument

' Rechercher le document de commissions correspondant aux paramètres a_Cle(0) = p_NoEquipe a_Cle(1) = p_Pays a_Cle(2) = p_Province Call xnd("", a_Cle, False, gndb_xSIRR, gc_NomVueComm_xSIRR, gnv_Comm_xSIRR, nd_Comm)
If nd_Comm Is Nothing Then If a_Cle(2) <> "" Then a_Cle(2) = "" Call xnd("", a_Cle, False, gndb_xSIRR, gc_NomVueComm_xSIRR, gnv_Comm_xSIRR, nd_Comm) End If
If nd_Comm Is Nothing Then If a_Cle(1) <> "" Then a_Cle(1) = "" Call xnd("", a_Cle, False, gndb_xSIRR, gc_NomVueComm_xSIRR, gnv_Comm_xSIRR, nd_Comm) End If End If End If
Set xSIRR_xndComm = nd_Comm End Function

Function xSIRR_xVarComm(Byval p_NoEquipe As String, Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Province As String, _ Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK"

Dim gndb_Temp_SITp As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SITp = "SL" Const gc_Element_SITp = "SI_Temp"

Function SITp_ndTemp(p_Description As String) As NotesDocument ' Fonction permettant de créer un nouveau document temporaire On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set SITp_ndTemp = Nothing
Set gndb_Temp_SITp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") If gndb_Temp_SITp Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_Temp_SITp.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If
Set SITp_ndTemp = New NotesDocument(gndb_Temp_SITp) SITp_ndTemp.Cle = Evaluate(|@Unique|) SITp_ndTemp.Description = p_Description SITp_ndTemp.HistoDC = Now SITp_ndTemp.HistoUC = ns.UserName Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SITp, gc_Element_SITp, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Temp" Use "SI_Historique" Use "x_GDK" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_Inst01"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim na As NotesAgent Dim ndb_SITp As NotesDatabase Dim nd_Temp As Notesdocument Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_ActiverProtection As String Dim nd_FInst As NotesDocument Dim v_NoteId As String
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set na = ns.CurrentAgent Set ndb_SITp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") Set nd_Temp = ndb_SITp.GetDocumentByID(na.ParameterDocID) Set nd_Prof = ndb.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof")
' Extraire le document des paramètres ' --------------------------------------------------- Set na = ns.CurrentAgent If na.ParameterDocID = "" Then Print "Erreur: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ")." Exit Sub End End If
' Extraire le document If nd_Temp Is Nothing Then Print "Erreur: Le document de paramètres est introuvable (" & gc_Element_A & ")." Exit Sub End End If
v_NoteId = xVar(nd_Temp, "DocumentSelectionne", "") Set nd_FInst = ndb.GetDocumentById(v_NoteId)
If Not nd_FInst Is Nothing Then
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(nd_FInst, "" ,"Action " & xVar(nd_Temp, "Action", "") & " : " & Chr(13) & xVar(nd_Temp, "Commentaire", "") , "", False) Then Exit Sub End If
' Copier les champs de l'historique Call SIHi_RemplacerHistorique(nd_FInst, nd_Temp, False)
v_ActiverProtection = xVar(nd_Temp, "ActiverProtection", "")
If v_ActiverProtection = "1" Then nd_FInst.Inst_60_DateProtection = "" End If
' Ré-initialise la date de protection If v_ActiverProtection = "" Then If xVar(nd_FInst, "Inst_60_Paye", "") = "1" Then If xVar(nd_FInst, "Inst_DateInstallation", "") <> "" Then nd_FInst.Inst_60_DateProtection = xVar(nd_FInst, "Inst_DateInstallation", "") + xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_Protection", 0) End If End If End If
nd_FInst.Inst_60_Paye = v_ActiverProtection
End If
' Copier les champs de l'historique Call SIHi_RemplacerHistorique(nd_Temp, nd_FInst, False)
Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(nd_FInst)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_CourrielsTypes"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_WFRInst"

Sub Initialize '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script perment d'envoyer un courriel de rappel pour les installation de type Maj. de version ' Le courriel est envoyer aux intervenants (type conversion seulement) si date installation = today ' et date provisoir pas coché. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations
' Traitement Call A_TraiterInstallations Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Sub A_TraiterInstallations On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Inst20 As NotesView Dim ndc_Inst As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_InstDateInstallation As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Ajouter As Boolean
' Initialisations Set nv_Inst20 = gndb_A.Getview("V_Inst20") Set ndc_Inst = gndb_A.CreateDocumentCollection()
Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv_Inst20.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Installation de type Maj. de version If xVar(nd, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") = "M" Or xVar(nd, "Inst_TypeInstallation", "") = "U" Then
v_InstDateInstallation = xVar(nd, "Inst_DateInstallation", Datenumber(2000, 01, 01)) v_Ajouter = False
If v_InstDateInstallation = Today Then Set ni = nd.GetFirstItem("Inst_Logiciels")
If ni.Contains("60") Then If xVar(nd, "Inst_60_DateConversionAffichee", "") = "1" Then v_Ajouter = False Else v_Ajouter = True End If End If
End If
If v_Ajouter Then If Not ndc_Inst.Contains(nd) Then Call ndc_Inst.AddDocument(nd) End If End If
End If Loop
If ndc_Inst.Count > 0 Then Call A_EnvoyerCourrielsRappel(ndc_Inst) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_EnvoyerCourrielsRappel(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Resp As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_RespSuivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Resp As NotesDocument Dim v_Destinataires() As String Dim i As Integer Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichtextItem
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations
Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
Set ndc_Resp = nd.Responses
If ndc_Resp.Count > 0 Then i = -1 Redim v_Destinataires(Cint(ndc_Resp.Count)) As String
Set nd_RespSuivant = ndc_Resp.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_RespSuivant Is Nothing Set nd_Resp = nd_RespSuivant Set nd_RespSuivant = ndc_Resp.GetNextDocument(nd_RespSuivant) ' Si type intervention = Conversion If xVar(nd_Resp, "Form", "") = "F_Inte" Then If xVar(nd_Resp, "Inte_TypeIntervention", "") = "05" Then i = i +1 v_Destinataires(i) = xVar(nd_Resp, "Inte_IdIntervenant", "") End If End If Loop
If i >= 0 Then Redim Preserve v_Destinataires(i) As String End If
' Envoyer le courriel '--------------------
If Isarray(v_Destinataires) Then Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd, "A_WFRInst", "FR", "" ,v_Destinataires, "", 0, False)
' Ajouter le lien vers l'installation Set nrti = nd_Courriel.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.AppendDocLink(nd, "Installation")
' Envoyer le message If Not (nd_Courriel Is Nothing) Then Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) End If
End If End If
Loop
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function xSICg_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICg_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSICg_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSICg_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSICg_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSICg_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSICg_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Exit For End If Next

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK"

Dim gns_VAdmS As notesSession Dim gndb_VAdmS As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VAdmS As notesuiworkspace Dim gnuiv_VAdmS As notesuiview
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VAdmS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VAdmS = "V_AdmS"

Sub VAdmS_acRestaurer '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_Restaurer As Boolean Dim v_HistoNS As String Dim nd_Parent As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 112, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Restaurer = False If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Set nd_Parent = nd.ParentDatabase.GetDocumentByUNID(xvar(nd, "HistoRS", "")) If Not (nd_Parent Is Nothing) Then v_Restaurer = True End If Else v_Restaurer = True End If
If v_Restaurer Then v_HistoNS = xVar(nd,"HistoNS","")
' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Parent) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoRS" ) End If nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
' Restaurer les sous-documents If v_HistoNS <> "" Then Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, v_HistoNS) End If End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView.Deselectall Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 114, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acViderCorbeille '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 211, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nv = gndb_VAdmS.GetView("V_AdmS") Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Supprimer le document Call nd.Remove(True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 113, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_Initialisations If gns_VAdmS Is Nothing Then Set gns_VAdmS = New notesSession Set gndb_VAdmS = gns_VAdmS.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_VAdmS = New notesuiworkspace Set gnuiv_VAdmS = gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView End If End Sub

Sub VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(pnd As Notesdocument, p_NoAdmS As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As Notesdocument
' Supprimer les documents réponses-de-réponses Set ndc = pnd.Responses If Not (ndc Is Nothing) Then If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If xVar(nd, "Form", "") <> "F_AdmS" Then ' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False)
' Restaurer les sous-documents Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, p_NoAdmS) End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop End If
End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acSupprimerSelection '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 111, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Restaurer les sous-documents Call nd.Remove(True)
v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 113, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SDS_Calendrier" Use "SDS_NotesMail" Use "SDS_Suivi" Use "SI_DatabaseScript"

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As Notesdatabase
Dim gnv_Inst20_A As NotesView Dim gnv_Cale21_A As NotesView Dim gnv_Inte20_A As NotesView
Dim g_DateHistorique_A As Variant
Const gc_JourInstallation = 6
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_MajJ" ' Inscrire l'alias de l'agent

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Print "A_MajJ: Début" Call A_Initialisations
' Traitement Call A_TraiterCalendrier Call A_TraiterInstallations Call A_TraiterSuivi
' Maj de l'agenda des installateurs Call A_MajAgenda
Print "A_MajJ: Fin" Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_MajAgenda On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NoIntervenant As String Dim ndb_Mail As NotesDatabase Dim nv_Evnt As NotesView Dim nd_Evnt As NotesDocument
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Print "A_MajAgenda - Début"
' Initialisations Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase Set nv = gndb_A.GetView("V_Inte22") Call nv.Refresh
' Boucler sur toutes les interventions par utilisateur Notes Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If xVar(nd, "Inte_AgendaMaj", "") = "1" Then If xSDSI_xContainsTypI(xVar(nd, "Inte_TypeIntervention", ""), "TypI_IntervenantOptions", "WF", True) Then ' Si changement d'utilisateur, ouvrir le courriel de l'utilisateur If xVar(nd, "Inte_NoIntervenant", "") <> v_NoIntervenant Then ' Supprimer les entrées d'agenda orphelines (dernier employé) If Not (nv_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Call A_SupprimerOrphelins(nv_Evnt) End If
v_NoIntervenant = xVar(nd, "Inte_NoIntervenant", "") Set ndb_Mail = SDSNM_ndbCourriel(v_NoIntervenant, nv_Evnt) End If
%REM If Not (nv_Evnt Is Nothing) Then If xVar(nd, "Inte_TypeInterventionUnite", "") = "1" Then ' Heures If xVar(nd, "Inte_DateInterventionDebut", "") >= Today Then If SDSNM_CreerReunion(nd, ndb_Mail, nv_Evnt) Then nd.Inte_AgendaMaj = "" Call nd.Save(True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If End If Else ' Jours If xVar(nd, "Inte_DateInterventionFin", "") >= Today Then If SDSNM_CreerEvenement(nd, ndb_Mail, nv_Evnt) Then nd.Inte_AgendaMaj = "" Call nd.Save(True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If End If End If End If %END REM End If End If Loop
' Supprimer les entrées d'agenda orphelines (dernier employé) If Not (nv_Evnt Is Nothing) Then Call A_SupprimerOrphelins(nv_Evnt) End If
Print "A_MajAgenda - Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_VerifierCalendrier(pnd As NotesDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Date As Variant Dim nd As Notesdocument
' Cacher les installations passées v_Date = xVar(pnd, "Cale_Date", "") If v_Date = "" Then Elseif v_Date < g_DateHistorique_A Then If xVar(pnd, "Cale_Expiree", "") <> "2" Then pnd.Cale_Expiree = "2" Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If Exit Sub Elseif v_Date < Today Then If xVar(pnd, "Cale_Expiree", "") <> "1" Then pnd.Cale_Expiree = "1" Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If Exit Sub End If
' Mettre à jour le statut du calendrier Call Cale_RafraichirCalendrier(v_Date, xVar(pnd, "Cale_InstallationHybride", "")) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_SupprimerOrphelins(pnv As NotesView) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inte As NotesDocument Dim v_Cle As String Dim v_ndbMail As String
If gnv_Inte20_A Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Inte20_A = gndb_A.GetView("V_Inte20") End If Call gnv_Inte20_A.Refresh
pnv.AutoUpdate = False
' Boucler sur toutes les interventions par utilisateur Notes Set nd_Suivant = pnv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pnv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
'Initialise la clé de recherche If nd.HasItem("SDSI_NoIntervention") Then 'Recherche vieille interventions avec ancienne clé. v_Cle = xVar(nd, "SDSI_NoIntervention", "") Else 'Recherche interventions avec nouvelle clé. v_Cle = Strright(xVar(nd, "SIEv_Reference", ""),";") End If
Set nd_Inte = gnv_Inte20_A.GetDocumentByKey(v_Cle)
If nd_Inte Is Nothing Then v_ndbMail = nd.ParentDatabase.Title If nd.HasItem("SDSI_NoIntervention") Or Strleft(xVar(nd, "SIEv_Reference", ""),";") = "SDSI" Then Call nd.Remove(True) Print "Intervention " & v_Cle & " retirée de l'agenda de " & v_ndbMail End If End If Loop
pnv.AutoUpdate = True Call pnv.Refresh Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_TraiterInstallations On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument
Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Inst20") Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
Call Suiv_CalculerJoursUtilises(xVar(nd, "Inst_NoInstallation", ""), "", "") Call Suivi_CalculerGratuites(xVar(nd, "Inst_NoInstallation", ""), "", "") Call A_VerifierInstallation(nd) Loop Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_TraiterSuivi ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script traite les documents de Suivi dont l'installation n'existe pas. ' Ces documents sont envoyés dans la corbeille. ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Inst As NotesView Dim nv_Suiv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Inst As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Set nv_Inst = gndb_A.Getview("V_Inst20") ' Vue des installations Set nv_Suiv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Suiv20") ' Vue des suivis
' Boucler sur tous les documents de Suivi Set nd_Suivant = nv_Suiv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv_Suiv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
' Extraire l'installation Set nd_Inst = nv_Inst.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd, "Suiv_NoInstallation", ""), True) ' Si elle n'existe pas, envoyer le document de Suivi dans la corbeille If nd_Inst Is Nothing Then Call SIDS_CorbeilleDocument(nd, "", "") v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print CStr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Print "A_MajJ: " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & " document(s) de suivi mis dans la corbeille." Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_TraiterCalendrier On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim nd As Notesdocument
' Vérifier les installations existantes Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Cale") Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
Call A_VerifierCalendrier(nd) Loop Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_VerifierInstallation(pnd As NotesDocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Cale As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Date As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Cacher les installations passées v_Date = xVar(pnd, "Inst_DateInstallation", "") If v_Date = "" Then Elseif v_Date < g_DateHistorique_A Then If xVar(pnd, "Inst_Expiree", "") <> "2" Then pnd.Inst_Expiree = "2" Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If Exit Sub Elseif v_Date < Today Then If xVar(pnd, "Inst_Expiree", "") <> "1" Then pnd.Inst_Expiree = "1" Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If Exit Sub End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime(Today)
If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase
Call ndt.SetAnyTime Call ndt.AdjustMonth(-18) g_DateHistorique_A = Datenumber(Year(ndt.LSLocalTime), Month(ndt.LSLocalTime), 1) End If End Sub

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gnuiws_SICJ As NotesUIWorkspace

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SICJ = "SL" Const gc_Element_SICJ = "SI_Jabber"

Function SICJ_DemarrerJabber(p_NoEmploye As String, p_Action As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim s As String
SICJ_DemarrerJabber = False
If p_NoEmploye = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Téléphoner ' ------------- If p_Action = "T" Then s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_PosteTelephonique", "", True) If SICJ_Telephoner(s) Then SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True End If
Exit Function End If
' Clavarder ' ------------- s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_NotesId", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
s = xNAB_xVarPerson(s, "InternetAddress", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "xmpp:" & Lcase(s), Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICJ_Telephoner(Byval p_NoTelephone As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
SICJ_Telephoner = False
If p_NoTelephone = "" Then Exit Function End If
p_NoTelephone = Lcase(Replace(p_NoTelephone, Evaluate(|" " : "-" : "(" : ")"|), "")) If Instr(p_NoTelephone, "x") > 0 Then p_NoTelephone = Strleft(p_NoTelephone, "x") End If
' If Len(p_NoTelephone) >= 7 Then ' p_NoTelephone = "9" & p_NoTelephone ' End If Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "ciscotel:" & p_NoTelephone, Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_Telephoner = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Set gnuiws_SICJ = New NotesUIWorkspace
SICJ_Initialisations = True End If
SICJ_Initialisations = True End Function

Declare Sub keybd_event Lib "user32" (ByVal bVk As Any, ByVal bScan As Any, ByVal dwFlags As Long,_ ByVal dwExtraInfo As Long)
