Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIDR = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIDR = "SI_DossierReseau"

Public Function SIDR_CreerCheminDossier(Byval p_Chemin As String, p_Utilisateur As String, p_MotPasse As String) As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a As Variant Dim v_Chemin As String Dim v_NbElem As Integer Dim i As Integer Dim v_CheminDossier As String Dim v_UniteReseau As String
SIDR_CreerCheminDossier = "" v_UniteReseau = ""
If Left(p_Chemin, 2) <> "\\" Then Exit Function End If
p_Chemin = Mid$(p_Chemin, 3) 'remove first 2 slashes a = Split(p_Chemin, "\") If Ubound(a) = 0 Then Exit Function End If
'----- Cherche un unité réseau qui n'est pas utilisé v_UniteReseau = SIDR_RechercheUniteReseau If v_UniteReseau = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Chemin = "\\" & a(0) & "\" & a(1) v_NbElem = 1 If Lcase(a(0)) = "serti.com" Then If Ubound(a) > 1 Then v_Chemin = v_Chemin & "\" & a(2) v_NbElem = 2 End If End If
If SIDR_ConnecterUniteReseau(v_UniteReseau, v_Chemin, p_Utilisateur, p_MotPasse) Then For i = v_NbElem + 1 To Ubound(a) v_CheminDossier = v_CheminDossier & "\" & a(i) Next
SIDR_CreerCheminDossier = v_UniteReseau & v_CheminDossier End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDR, gc_Element_SIDR, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Function SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau(p_LettreUniteReseau As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_UnitesReseau As Variant Dim v_Reseau As Variant Dim v_LettresReseau As String Dim i As Integer
SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau = False
Set v_Reseau = createobject("WScript.Network") Set v_UnitesReseau = v_Reseau.EnumNetworkDrives()
For i = 0 To v_UnitesReseau.Count() - 1 Step 2 v_LettresReseau = Lcase(v_UnitesReseau.Item(i)) If v_LettresReseau = Lcase(p_LettreUniteReseau) Then SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau = True Exit For End If Next
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDR, gc_Element_SIDR, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Function SIDR_ConnecterUniteReseau (p_UniteReseau As String, p_CheminDossierPartage As String, p_Utilisateur As String, p_MotPasse As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_WshNetwork As Variant
SIDR_ConnecterUniteReseau = False Set v_WshNetwork = createobject("WScript.Network")
If Not SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau(p_UniteReseau) Then Call v_WshNetwork.MapNetworkDrive(p_UniteReseau, p_CheminDossierPartage, "FALSE" , p_Utilisateur, p_MotPasse) End If
SIDR_ConnecterUniteReseau = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDR, gc_Element_SIDR, Getthreadinfo(1), p_UniteReseau & " <-- " & p_CheminDossierPartage & " (" & p_Utilisateur & ")", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDR_RechercheUniteReseau As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_LettreASCII As Integer Dim tmp As String
SIDR_RechercheUniteReseau = ""
'----- Cherche un unité réseau qui n'est pas utilisé For v_LettreASCII = 90 To 72 Step -1 'Lettre ASCII: 90 = Z 70 = H tmp = Chr$(v_LettreASCII) & ":" If Not(SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau(tmp)) Then SIDR_RechercheUniteReseau = tmp Exit For End If Next v_LettreASCII
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDR, gc_Element_SIDR, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Function SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau Description: Cette fonction déconnecte un unité réseau %END REM Function SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau(Byval p_Chemin As String, p_Force As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_UniteReseau As String Dim v_Reseau As Variant
SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau = False
v_UniteReseau = Left$(p_Chemin, 2) If Instr(v_UniteReseau, ":") = 0 Then Print "SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau > ***ERREUR : Unité réseau non valide: " & v_UniteReseau Exit Function End If
Set v_Reseau = createobject("WScript.Network") Call v_Reseau.RemoveNetworkDrive(Lcase(v_UniteReseau), p_Force)
SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDR, gc_Element_SIDR, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN= "SL" Const gc_Element_SLFWIN = "SL_FichierWIN"
Const FILE_SHARE_READ = &H1 Const OPEN_EXISTING = 3 Const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE = &H20 Const GENERIC_READ = &H80000000
Declare Function CreateFile Lib "kernel32.dll" Alias "CreateFileA" (Byval lpFileName As String, Byval dwDesiredAccess As Long, Byval dwShareMode As Long, lpSecurityAttributes As Any, Byval dwCreationDisposition As Long, Byval dwFlagsAndAttributes As Long, Byval hTemplateFile As Long) As Long Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32.dll" (Byval hObject As Long) As Long
Type FILETIME dwLowDateTime As Long dwHighDateTime As Long End Type
Type SYSTEMTIME wYear As Integer wMonth As Integer wDayOfWeek As Integer wDay As Integer wHour As Integer wMinute As Integer wSecond As Integer wMilliseconds As Integer End Type
Declare Function FileTimeToLocalFileTime Lib "kernel32.dll" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpLocalFileTime As FILETIME) As Long Declare Function GetFileTime& Lib "kernel32" (Byval hFile As Long, lpCreationTime As FILETIME, lpLastAccessTime As FILETIME, lpLastWriteTime As FILETIME) Declare Function FileTimeToSystemTime& Lib "kernel32" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpSystemTime As SYSTEMTIME)

Function SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_NomFichier As String) As String ' RQ51336 PBE ' Retourne un nom de fichier unique en ajoutent "(n)" au nom du fichier au besoin ' Fichier ABC.PDF --> Fichier ABC (2).pdf ' p_NomFichier : Le nom du fichier doit inclure le chemin d'accès On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Continuer As Boolean Dim v_Dossier As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_Suffixe As String Dim i As integer Dim v_NomFichierUnique As String Dim s As string
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = p_NomFichier v_Continuer = False
If p_NomFichier <> "" Then If InStr(p_NomFichier, "\") > 0 Then s = Dir$(p_NomFichier, 0) If s <> "" Then v_Continuer = True End If End If End If
If v_Continuer then v_Dossier = StrLeftBack(p_NomFichier, "\") & "\" v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(p_NomFichier, "\")
If InStr(v_NomFichier, ".") > 0 Then v_Suffixe = "." & StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, ".") v_NomFichier = StrLeftBack(v_NomFichier, ".") Else v_Suffixe = "" End If
i = 1 Do i = i + 1 v_NomFichierUnique = v_Dossier & v_NomFichier & " (" & CStr(i) & ")" & v_Suffixe s = Dir$(v_NomFichierUnique) Loop Until s = ""
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = v_NomFichierUnique End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomFichier, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_DateFichier(p_CheminFichier As String, p_TypeInfo As String) As Variant '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourne les date de création, modif ou consutation d'un fichier windows. ' Paramètres : p_TypeInfo ---> Le type info fichier a retourner ( C = date création, M = date modification, A = date dern. accès) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 76 Goto FichierInexistant
Dim v_ValRetour As Long ' valeur de retour Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_Fichier As Long ' handle du fichier ouvert Dim v_DateCreation As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure de création Dim v_DateDernAcces As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure dernière consultation Dim v_DateModif As FILETIME ' varible pour date et heure de dernière modification Dim v_DateFichier As SYSTEMTIME ' variable pour manipuler l'heure et date de FILETIME
' Initialisations SLFWIN_DateFichier = ""
If Dir$(p_CheminFichier) = "" Then Goto FichierInexistant End If
v_Fichier = CreateFile(p_CheminFichier, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, Byval Clng(0), OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE, 0) If v_Fichier = -1 Then Exit Function End If
' Retourne heures...creation, dern-accès, and dern-modification. v_ValRetour = GetFileTime(v_Fichier, v_DateCreation, v_DateDernAcces, v_DateModif)
' Fermer la connection au fichier. v_ValRetour = CloseHandle(v_Fichier) If v_ValRetour = 0 Then Print "ERREUR - Le fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " n'a pas été fermé normalement. (" & Cstr(v_ValRetour) & ")" End If
' Convertir la zone pour l'heure et Convertir le format FILETIME en format SYSTEMTIME Select Case p_TypeInfo Case "C" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateCreation) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateFichier) Case "M" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateModif, v_DateModif) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateModif, v_DateFichier) Case "A" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateDernAcces) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateFichier) End Select
v_Date = Evaluate(| @Date(| & v_DateFichier.wYear & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMonth & |;| & v_DateFichier.wDay & _ |;| & v_DateFichier.wHour & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMinute & |;| & v_DateFichier.wSecond & |) |)
If Isarray(v_Date) Then SLFWIN_DateFichier = v_Date(0) End If Exit Function
FichierInexistant: Print "Fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " introuvable." Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String, p_CheminFichierDestination As String, p_Remplacer As Boolean) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de convertir un fichier en base 64. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_FichierTempOrigine As Boolean Dim v_CheminFichierOrigine As String Dim v_CheminFichierTempDestination As String Dim a_Commande(1) As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim i As integer Dim v_Resultat As Integer
' Initialisations SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = False
' Validation des paramètres If p_CheminFichierOrigine = "" Then Exit function End If If Dir$(p_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) = "" Then Exit function End If
v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierOrigine p_CheminFichierDestination = Replace(p_CheminFichierDestination, |’|, |-|)
v_FichierTempOrigine = False If InStr(v_CheminFichierOrigine, |’|) > 0 Then v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp1" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End If FileCopy p_CheminFichierOrigine, v_CheminFichierOrigine v_FichierTempOrigine = True End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then If p_Remplacer then Kill p_CheminFichierDestination Else p_CheminFichierDestination = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminFichierDestination) End if End If
' Suppression du fichier temporaire v_CheminFichierTempDestination = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp2" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
' ===== Encodage du fichier ===== ' certutil -encode [Origine] [Temporaire] && findstr /v /c:- [Temp] > [Destination] && del [Temp] %rem a_Commande(0) = |/c certutil -encode "| & p_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| a_Commande(1) = |/c findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| a_Commande(2) = |/c del "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| %end rem
a_Commande(0) = |certutil -encode "| & v_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |"| a_Commande(1) = |findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| v_Commande = |/c | & Implode(a_Commande, |&&|) v_Resultat = ShellExecute(0&, "open", "cmd", v_Commande, "", SW_HIDE) If v_Resultat < 32 Then Exit Function End If
' Attendre jusqu'à ce que le fichier encodé soit créé Do If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then Exit Do End If Sleep 1 i = i + 1 Loop Until i > 10 ' Maximum 10 secondes
' Supprimer les fichier temporaires On Error 75 Resume next If v_FichierTempOrigine Then If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End if End If If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine & " --> " & p_CheminFichierDestination, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_LireFichierString(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim v_Texte As String
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = ""
v_NoFichier = FreeFile Open p_CheminFichierOrigine For Input As #v_NoFichier Do Until EOF(v_NoFichier) Line Input #v_NoFichier, s v_Texte = v_Texte & s Loop Close #v_NoFichier
SLFWIN_LireFichierString = v_Texte Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString(p_Data As String, p_CheminFichier As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim v_Texte As String
SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString = False
On Error 75 Resume next Kill p_CheminFichier
v_NoFichier = FreeFile Open p_CheminFichier For Output As #v_NoFichier Write #p_Data Close #v_NoFichier
SLFWIN_SauvegarderFichierString = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichier, False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_DossierReseau" Use "SI_FichierWIN"

Dim gns_A As notesSession Dim gndb_A As notesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_DLien"

Sub Initialize '========================================================== ' Le script permet de maj la date de modification du ficher associé au lien. ' Note : Le lien peut être un fichier attaché ou un lien réseau. '========================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_UniteReseau As String Dim v_CheminDossierPartage As String Dim v_Utilisateur As String Dim v_MotPasse As String
' Initialisations Print "Début" Call A_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
v_UniteReseau = "S:" ' v_CheminDossierPartage = "\\serti.com\serti_data\sds" v_CheminDossierPartage = "\\serti.com\serti_data\sds\sds"
' Connecter le lecteur réseau (S:) If SIDR_VerifierUniteReseau(v_UniteReseau) Then Call SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau(v_UniteReseau, True) End If v_Utilisateur = xGDK_xVarProf("Prof_Reseau_Utilisateur", "") v_MotPasse = xGDK_xVarProf("Prof_Reseau_MotDePasse", "") If SIDR_ConnecterUniteReseau (v_UniteReseau, v_CheminDossierPartage, v_Utilisateur, v_MotPasse) = False Then Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ "ERREUR: - La connection " & v_UniteReseau & "\" & v_CheminDossierPartage & " a échoué!" , "", True) GoTo EnregistrerLog End If
' Traitement principal Call A_TraiterDocuments(v_UniteReseau)
' Déconnecter le lecteur réseau (S:) Call SIDR_DeconnecterUniteReseau(v_UniteReseau, True)
EnregistrerLog: Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument
If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New Notessession Set gndb_A = gns_A.Currentdatabase End If
End Sub

Sub A_TraiterDocuments(p_UniteReseau As String) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de vérifier si il y a déja une connection UNC '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 76 Resume next
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndt_Now As New NotesDateTime(Now) Dim ndt_DateModif As NotesDateTime Dim v_NbHrs As Double Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_DMLien As String Dim v_Lien As String Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject Dim v_Fichier As String Dim s As string
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Set nv = gndb_A.GetView("V_Docu10")
' Boucler sur tous les documents Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
Set ndt_DateModif = New NotesDateTime("") ndt_DateModif.LSLocalTime = xVar(nd, "HistoDM", xVar(nd, "HistoDC" , Now)) v_NbHrs = (ndt_Now.TimeDifference(ndt_DateModif) / 60) / 60
' Vérifier les documents modifié depuis les dernier 72 hrs. If v_NbHrs =< 72 Then
v_Maj = False v_DMLien = ""
v_Lien = xVar(nd, "Docu_Lien", "")
' Si lien réseau If xVar(nd, "Docu_Type", "") = "0" Then If Ucase(Left(v_Lien, 1)) = Ucase(Left(p_UniteReseau,1)) Then s = Dir$(v_Lien, 0) If s <> "" then ' If UCase(Left(v_Lien, 1)) = || Then ' v_Lien = "s:\" ' End If ' retourne la date de modification du fichier v_DMLien = SLFWIN_DateFichier(v_Lien, "M") If xVar(nd, "Docu_LienDM", "") <> v_DMLien Then nd.Docu_LienDM = v_DMLien v_Maj = True Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Date maj : " & v_Lien, 0, 0, True) Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Pas de maj requise : " & v_Lien, 0, 0, True) End if Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fichier non trouvé : " & v_Lien, 0, 0, True) End If Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Dossier non supporté : " & v_Lien, 0, 0, True) End If End If
' Si fichier attaché If xVar(nd, "Docu_Type", "") = "1" Then Set nrti = nd.GetFirstItem("Docu_Document") If Isarray(nrti.EmbeddedObjects) Then Set neo = nrti.EmbeddedObjects(0) On Error 75 Resume Next Mkdir(Environ("Temp") & "\SDSI") v_Fichier = Environ("Temp") & "\SDSI\" & neo.Name Kill v_Fichier Call neo.ExtractFile(v_Fichier) ' retourne la date de modification du fichier v_DMLien = SLFWIN_DateFichier(v_Fichier, "M") If xVar(nd, "Docu_LienDM", "") <> v_DMLien Then nd.Docu_LienDM = v_DMLien v_Maj = True
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Date maj : " & neo.name, 0, 0, True) End If Kill v_Fichier End If End If
If v_Maj Then Call nd.save(True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If
End If Loop
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, True) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), v_Lien, False) Exit Sub End Sub

Const wAPIModule = "NNOTES" ' Windows Const NSF_INFO_SIZE = 128 Const INFOPARSE_DESIGN = 3 Const NOTE_ID_ICON = &HFFFF0010
Declare Private Function DesignRefresh Lib wAPIModule Alias "DesignRefresh" _ ( Byval S As String, Byval hDB As Long, Byval F As Long, Byval zA As Long, Byval zM As Long) As Integer
Declare Private Function OSPathNetConstruct Lib wAPIModule Alias "OSPathNetConstruct" _ ( Byval zP As Long, Byval S As String, Byval F As String, Byval N As String) As Integer
Declare Private Function NSFDbInfoGet Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoGet" _ ( Byval hDB As Long, Byval D As String) As Integer Declare Private Sub NSFDbInfoModify Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoModify" _ ( Byval S As String, Byval W As Integer, Byval D As String) Declare Private Function NSFDbInfoSet Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoSet" _ ( Byval hDB As Long, Byval D As String) As Integer

' Utilisé par VNDB_ChangerIDReplique Type TIMEDATE Innards(1) As Long End Type Type DBREPLICAINFO ID As TIMEDATE 'ID that is same for all replica files Flags As Integer 'Replication flags CutoffInterval As Integer 'Automatic Replication Cutoff Cutoff As TIMEDATE 'Replication cutoff date End Type Declare Function W32_NSFDbOpen Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbOpen" ( Byval dbName As String, hdb As Long ) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbClose Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbClose" ( Byval hdb As Long ) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbReplicaInfoGet" (Byval hdb As Long, hdbr As DBREPLICAINFO) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbReplicaInfoSet" (Byval hdb As Long, hdbr As DBREPLICAINFO) As Integer
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINDB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINDB = "SI_NotesDatabase"

Sub SINDB_RefreshDesign(templateserver$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim s As Integer Dim hDB As Long s% = NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB) If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Sub SINDB_SetDesignTemplate(templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ndGetDesignElement(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_TypeElement As String, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument ' PAS TESTÉ ************************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection Dim s As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nnc = pndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) Select Case p_TypeElement Case "F": nnc.SelectForms = True Case "V": nnc.SelectViews = True Case Else Call nnc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) End Select ' nnc.SelectionFormula = |@IsMember("F_Tabl"; @GetField("$Title"))| Call nnc.BuildCollection
s = nnc.Getfirstnoteid Do Until s = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentById(s) Set ni = nd.Getfirstitem("$TITLE") If ni.Contains(p_NomElement) Then Set SINDB_ndGetDesignElement = nd Exit Do End If s = nnc.Getnextnoteid(s) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_ReplaceDesign(templateserver$, templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
Dim hNT As Long NSFNoteOpen hDB, NOTE_ID_ICON, 0, hNT NSFItemSetText hNT, "$TITLE", d$, Instr(d$, Chr$(0)) NSFNoteUpdate hNT, 0 NSFNoteClose hNT
DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nr As NotesReplication
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = False
If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit function End If
Set nr = pndb.ReplicationInfo
Call nr.ClearHistory() Call nr.Save()
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = W32_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SI_DXL" Use "x_SICl"

Dim gns_SDSISd As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSISd As NotesDatabase Dim gnuiws_SDSISd As NotesUIWorkspace
Dim g_NoInstallation_SDSISd As String
Const gc_NomVueCont_xSDSISd = "V_Cont11"
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSISd = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSISd = "SDS_Sondage"

Sub Initialize
' Le script permet d'envoyer un couriel sondage au contacts d'un client ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Print "Début" Call SDSISd_Initialisations
Print "Fin" Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSISd, gc_Element_SDSISd , Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSISd_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean
'Traitement et envoi de courriel sondage au contacts selectionés du client '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courrieltype As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courrieltmp As NotesDocument
Dim v_Courriel As String Dim v_NbDest As Integer
Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Client As NotesDocument
Dim ndb_courriel As NotesDatabase Dim ndb_SICo As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim nv As NotesView Dim v_UNID As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_ContactCourriel As String
Dim v_ClientLangue As String Dim v_ContactLangue As String Dim v_SondageLangue As String Dim v_tmpLangue As String
Dim v_DefinirLangue As Boolean
Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim ndomp As NotesDOMParser Dim ndxli As NotesDXLImporter
SDSISd_EnvoyerCourriel = False
Call SDSISd_Initialisations
Set nv = gndb_SDSISd.GetView("V_SICT20") Set nd_Courrieltype = nv.GetDocumentByKey("A_Sond", False)
If nd_Courrieltype Is Nothing Then
Print "Courriel type Sondage non defini" Exit Function End If
'------------- List des contacts client a partir de la base SI Contacts
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", "") 'db cible :SI Contacts Set ndb_SICo = xGDK_xndbNDB("SICo")
'db cible: SI Clients, Langue du client Set nd_Client = xSICl_xndClie (xVar(pnd,"Inst_ClientNoFmt", ""), False) v_ClientLangue =xVar(nd_Client,"Clie_ClientLangue", "FR")
Set ndc = gnuiws_SDSISd.PickListCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, True, gndb_SDSISd.Server, ndb_SICo.FilePath, gc_NomVueCont_xSDSISd,_ xGDK_xMessage("SDSI", 13, "", ""), xGDK_xMessage("SDSI", 12, "", ""), v_ClientNoFmt )
' ------------- Vérifier si l'utilisateur a fait un choix de contact If ndc.count = 0 Then Print "Operation annulée" Exit Function End If
' ------------- Definir la langue du sondage
v_SondageLangue = v_ClientLangue
Redim a_Destinataires (ndc.count - 1) As String v_NbDest = 0
v_DefinirLangue = True Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument
v_ContactLangue = xVAR(nd_Suivant, "Cont_ContactLangue", "") If v_ContactLangue <> "" Then 'Valeur initiale v_tmpLangue = v_ContactLangue End If
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing
Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
'------------- Construire la liste des contacts destinataires v_Courriel = xVAR(nd, "Cont_ContactCourriel", "") v_ContactLangue = xVAR(nd, "Cont_ContactLangue", "")
If v_Courriel <> "" Then a_Destinataires(v_NbDest) = v_Courriel v_NbDest = v_NbDest + 1
'Verifier la langue du Contact sélectioné v_ContactLangue = xVAR(nd, "Cont_ContactLangue", "")
If Not v_ContactLangue <> "" And v_DefinirLangue = True Then
If Not v_tmpLangue <> "" Then
If v_tmpLangue <> v_ContactLangue Then 'On utilise la langue du client (valeur par défaut) v_SondageLangue = v_ClientLangue v_DefinirLangue = False Else v_SondageLangue = v_ContactLangue End If
Else 'valeur initiale v_tmpLangue = v_ContactLangue End If
End If
End If
Loop
'------------- Traitement des nodes et envoi de courriel sondage au contacts selectionés If v_NbDest > 0 Then Redim Preserve a_Destinataires (v_NbDest - 1) As String
Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(Nothing, "A_Sond", v_SondageLangue, Fulltrim(a_Destinataires), "", "", 2, 0) Call nd_Courriel.Save(True,False)
v_UNID = nd_Courriel.UniversalID Set ndb_courriel = nd_Courriel.ParentDatabase
'Clé g_NoInstallation_SDSISd = xVar (pnd, "Inst_NoInstallation", "")
Set ndxle = gns_SDSISd.CreateDXLExporter(nd_Courriel) Set ndomp = gns_SDSISd.CreateDOMParser(ndxle)
On Event PostDOMParse From ndomp Call SDSISd_TraiterDOM
Set ndxli = gns_SDSISd.CreateDXLImporter(ndomp, ndb_courriel) ndxli.Documentimportoption = DXLIMPORTOPTION_REPLACE_ELSE_IGNORE ndxle.Process
'Supprimer l'objet document nd_Courriel Delete nd_Courriel
'Envoyer le message Set nd_courrieltmp = ndb_courriel.GetDocumentByUNID(v_UNID)
If Not nd_courrieltmp Is Nothing Then
Call nd_courrieltmp.Send(False)
SDSISd_EnvoyerCourriel = True
End If
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSISd, gc_Element_SDSISd, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub SDSISd_TraiterDOM(pndomp As NotesDOMParser) 'Traitement des nodes & attributes de DXL du courriel sondage (contenant le lien hotspot) '----------------------------------------------------------------------
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndomdn As NotesDOMDocumentNode Dim ndomnl As NotesDOMNodeList Dim ndomen As NotesDOMElementNode Dim ndomn_Enfant As NotesDOMNode
Dim i As Long Dim v_NbrNodes As Long Dim v_Url As String Dim v_UrlInst As Variant
Set ndomdn = pndomp.Document
Set ndomnl = ndomdn.GetElementsByTagName("formula")
For i = 1 To ndomnl.NumberOfEntries Set ndomen = ndomnl.GetItem(i)
Set ndomn_Enfant = ndomen.FirstChild v_NbrNodes = ndomen.NumberOfChildNodes While v_NbrNodes > 0
If Not ndomn_Enfant.IsNull Then If Instr (ndomn_Enfant.Nodevalue, "[Inst_NoInstallation]") > 0 Then '
v_url = ndomn_Enfant.Nodevalue v_urlInst = Replace(v_url, "[Inst_NoInstallation]", g_NoInstallation_SDSISd) ndomn_Enfant.Nodevalue = v_urlInst
Exit For End If End If
Set ndomn_Enfant = ndomn_Enfant.NextSibling v_NbrNodes = v_NbrNodes - 1 Wend
Next
pndomp.Serialize
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSISd, gc_Element_SDSISd, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Dim g_Signet As Variant Dim gl_ParamCellules As gcl_CCellule_SIDXL Dim g_PoliceDefaut As String Dim g_TaillePoliceDefaut As String Dim g_CouleurPoliceDefaut As String
'Const gc_LigneBlanche_SIDXL = "<par><run><font size='9pt' name='Arial' pitch='variable' truetype='true' familyid='20'/></run></par>" Const gc_LigneBlanche_SIDXL = "<par/>"

End Class

Function SIDXL_RemplacerSignetRT(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Signet As String, p_Valeur As String) _ As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim v_DXL As String Dim p As Long Dim q As Long Dim v_Gauche As String Dim v_Droite As String Dim ndxli As NotesDXLImporter
' Initialisations SIDXL_RemplacerSignetRT = False Call SIDXL_Initialisations ' Convertir le document Notes en XML Set ndxle = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLExporter On Error Goto GererErreurDXLe v_DXL = ndxle.Export(pnd) On Error Goto GererErreur
' Trouver l'item p = Instr(1, v_DXL, |<item name='| & p_NomItem & |'|, 1) If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Vérifier si l'item est de type RichText p = Instr(p, v_DXL, ">", 1) + 1 If Mid(v_DXL, p, 10) <> "<richtext>" Then Exit Function End If p = p + 10
' Trouver la fin de la valeur de l'item q = Instr(p, v_DXL, "</richtext>", 1) - 1 If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Trouver le signet p = Instr(p, v_DXL, p_Signet, 1) If p = 0 Or p > q Then Exit Function End If ' Trouver le début du document (à gauche du signet) v_Gauche = Left(v_DXL, p) v_Gauche = Strleftback(v_Gauche, "<par", 1) ' Trouver la fin du document (à droite du signet) q = p + Len(p_Signet) - 1 v_Droite = Right(v_DXL, Len(v_DXL) - q) v_Droite = Strright(v_Droite, "</par>", 1)
' Remplacer le signet v_DXL = v_Gauche & p_Valeur & v_Droite
' Convertir le document XML en Notes Set ndxli = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLImporter ndxli.DocumentImportOption = DXLIMPORTOPTION_UPDATE_ELSE_IGNORE On Error Goto GererErreurDXLi Call ndxli.Import(v_DXL, gndb_SIDXL)
SIDXL_RemplacerSignetRT = True Exit Function
GererErreurDXLe: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxle.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreurDXLi: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxli.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDXL_DefinirNDB(pndb As Notesdatabase) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de définir la base de documents ou on doit exporter le fiche temporaire ' A utiliser seulement lorsque la base de documents à utiliser n'est ' pas la base de documents courante. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
SIDXL_DefinirNDB = False
Set gndb_SIDXL = pndb
If Not (pndb Is Nothing) Then SIDXL_DefinirNDB = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDXL_DocumentRemplacerSignets(pnd_Source As NotesDocument, pnd_Data As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de faire un trouver/remplacer dans un document '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim ndb_Source As NotesDatabase Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim ndxli As NotesDXLImporter Dim nn As NotesName Dim v_ValeurItem As String Dim v_Signet As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_ErreurDXL As String
SIDXL_DocumentRemplacerSignets = False Call SIDXL_Initialisations Set ndb_Source = pnd_Source.Parentdatabase
Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_SIDXL) ' Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(ndb_Source) ' nd_Temp.Form = "Memo"
' Convertir le document source en XML (dans le NotesStream) Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(nd_Temp, "Body") Set ndxle = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLExporter(pnd_Source, nrti) Call ndxle.Process ' Call nd_Temp.Save(True, False)
' Remplacer les signets dans le NotesStream If Not (pnd_Data Is Nothing) Then ForAll ni In pnd_Data.Items If Left(ni.Name, 1) <> "$" Then If ni.IsNames Then Set nn = New NotesName(ni.Text) v_ValeurItem = nn.Abbreviated Else v_ValeurItem = ni.Text End If
If v_ValeurItem = "" Then v_ValeurItem = " " End If
v_Signet = "[" & LCase(ni.Name) & "]" Call SItRT_Remplacer(nrti, v_Signet, v_ValeurItem) End If End ForAll End If
' Call nd_Temp.save(True, False)
' Réimporter le document modifié Set ndxli = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLImporter(nrti, ndb_Source) ndxli.Documentimportoption = DXLIMPORTOPTION_REPLACE_ELSE_IGNORE Call ndxli.Process
Call nrti.Remove SIDXL_DocumentRemplacerSignets = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call nrti.Remove If Not (ndxli Is Nothing) then v_ErreurDXL = ndxli.Log End if Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), v_ErreurDXL, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDXL_ExtraireValeurRT(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String) As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim v_DXL As String Dim p As Long Dim q As Long
' Initialisations SIDXL_ExtraireValeurRT = "" If Not pnd.HasItem(p_NomItem) Then Exit Function End If Call SIDXL_Initialisations
' Vérifier si l'item est de type Rich Text Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomItem) If ni.Type <> 1 Then Exit Function Elseif ni.Text = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Convertir le document Notes en XML Set ndxle = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLExporter v_DXL = ndxle.Export(pnd)
' Trouver l'item p = Instr(1, v_DXL, |<item name='| & p_NomItem & |'>|, 1) If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Vérifier si l'item est de type RichText p = Instr(p, v_DXL, ">", 1) + 1 Print Mid(v_DXL, p, 50) If Mid(v_DXL, p, 10) <> "<richtext>" Then Exit Function End If p = p + 10
' Trouver la fin de la valeur de l'item q = Instr(p, v_DXL, "</richtext>", 1) If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Retourner la valeur de l'item SIDXL_ExtraireValeurRT = Mid(v_DXL, p, q - p) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIDXL_CollectionCellulesRT(p_Source As NotesDOMParser) %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Le script permet de boucler dans un élément tableau XML et modifier le couleur de fond des ' cellules. Paramètres: p_Source NotesDOMParser. Le document XML qui contient le tableau ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %ENDREM On Error Goto GererErreur Dim nddn As NotesDOMDocumentNode Dim ndnl As NotesDOMNodeList Dim nden As NotesDOMElementNode Dim i As Long Dim ndn_Enfant As NotesDOMNode Dim NbrNodes As Long
' Initialisations Set nddn = p_Source.Document 'Set ndnl = nddn.GetElementsByTagName("table")
' Collection de cellules du tableau Set ndnl = nddn.GetElementsByTagName("tablecell")
' Boucler tous les cellules de la table For i = 1 To ndnl.NumberOfEntries Set nden = ndnl.GetItem(i)
Set ndn_Enfant = nden.FirstChild NbrNodes = nden.NumberOfChildNodes While NbrNodes > 0 Set ndn_Enfant = ndn_Enfant.NextSibling NbrNodes = NbrNodes - 1 Call SIDXL_ModifierCelluleRT(ndn_Enfant, nden) Wend
Next
' Enregistrer les changements Call p_Source.Serialize
Exit Sub GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub SIDXL_Initialisations If gns_SIDXL Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIDXL = New NotesSession End If If gndb_SIDXL Is Nothing Then Set gndb_SIDXL = gns_SIDXL.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Function SIDXL_AjouterValeurRT(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As String) _ As Boolean
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim v_DXL As String Dim p As Long Dim q As Long Dim v_Gauche As String Dim v_Droite As String Dim ndxli As NotesDXLImporter
' Initialisations SIDXL_AjouterValeurRT = False Call SIDXL_Initialisations
' Convertir le document Notes en XML Set ndxle = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLExporter On Error Goto GererErreurDXLe v_DXL = ndxle.Export(pnd) On Error Goto GererErreur
' Trouver l'item p = Instr(1, v_DXL, |<item name='| & p_NomItem & |'|, 1) If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Vérifier si l'item est de type RichText p = Instr(p, v_DXL, ">", 1) + 1 If Mid(v_DXL, p, 10) <> "<richtext>" Then Exit Function End If Print "1." & Mid(v_DXL, p, 100) p = p + 10
' Trouver la fin de la valeur de l'item q = Instr(p, v_DXL, "</richtext>", 1) - 1 If p = 0 Then Exit Function End If Print "2." & Mid(v_DXL, q, 100) v_Gauche = Left(v_DXL, q) Print "3." & Right(v_Gauche, 100) v_Droite = Right(v_DXL, Len(v_DXL) - q) Print "4." & Left(v_Droite, 100) Stop
' Ajouter la valeur v_DXL = v_Gauche & p_Valeur & v_Droite
' Convertir le document XML en Notes Set ndxli = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLImporter Set ndxli = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLImporter ndxli.DocumentImportOption = DXLIMPORTOPTION_UPDATE_ELSE_IGNORE On Error Goto GererErreurDXLi Call ndxli.Import(v_DXL, gndb_SIDXL)
SIDXL_AjouterValeurRT = True Exit Function
GererErreurDXLe: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxle.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreurDXLi: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxli.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIDXL_ModifierCellulesRT(pnd As NotesDocument, pl_ParamCellules As gcl_CCellule_SIDXL, _ p_PoliceDefaut, p_TaillePoliceDefaut, p_CouleurPoliceDefaut) As Boolean %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Le script permet de modifier les couleurs de fond des cellules d'un tableau dans un champ rich text. Paramètres: pnd Document. Le document qui contient le tableau rich text pl_ParamCellules gcl_CCellule_SIDXL. Permet de modifier des propriétés de cellules p_PoliceDefaut. La police qu'on veut assigner aux cellules par défaut p_TaillePoliceDefaut. La taille de police qu'on veut assinger aux cellules par défaut p_CouleurPoliceDefaut. La couleur de police qu'on veut assinger aux cellules par défaut
' Note: SI pnd est un nouveau document, il faut l'enregistrer avant de modifer les cellules. Le script s'execute mais, ' on ne voit pas les changements ? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %ENDREM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndxle As NotesDXLExporter Dim ndxli As NotesDXLImporter Dim ndxlp As NotesDOMParser
' Initialisations SIDXL_ModifierCellulesRT = False Call SIDXL_Initialisations
Set gl_ParamCellules = pl_ParamCellules g_PoliceDefaut = p_PoliceDefaut g_TaillePoliceDefaut = p_TaillePoliceDefaut g_CouleurPoliceDefaut = p_CouleurPoliceDefaut
' Convertir le document Notes en XML Set ndxle = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLExporter(pnd) Set ndxlp = gns_SIDXL.CreateDOMParser(ndxle) On Error Goto GererErreurDXLe
On Event PostDOMParse From ndxlp Call SIDXL_CollectionCellulesRT
' Convertir le document XML en Notes Set ndxli = gns_SIDXL.CreateDXLImporter(ndxlp, gndb_SIDXL)
ndxli.DocumentImportOption = DXLIMPORTOPTION_REPLACE_ELSE_IGNORE On Error Goto GererErreurDXLe ndxle.Process
On Error Goto GererErreur
SIDXL_ModifierCellulesRT= True Exit Function
GererErreurDXLe: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxle.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreurDXLi: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), ndxli.Log, False) Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIDXL_ModifierCelluleRT(p_Node As NotesDomNode, p_nden As NotesDOMElementNode) ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de maj le couleur de fond des cellules ' Paramètres: ' p_Note NotesDomNode. Le node parent ' p_nden NotesDOMElementNode. Le élément parent (cellule) ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndn_Enfant As NotesDOMNode Dim nden As NotesDOMElementNode Dim NbrNodesEnfant As Integer Dim NbrEnfants As Integer Dim ndtn As NotesDOMTextNode Dim v_Couleur As String Dim v_NouvValeur As String Dim v_Police As String Dim v_TaillePolice As String Dim v_CouleurPolice As String
If Not p_Node.IsNull Then
Select Case p_Node.NodeType Case DOMNODETYPE_DOCUMENT_NODE: Set ndn_Enfant = p_Node.FirstChild NbrNodesEnfant = p_Node.NumberOfChildNodes
While NbrNodesEnfant > 0 Set ndn_Enfant = ndn_Enfant.NextSibling NbrNodesEnfant = NbrNodesEnfant - 1 Call SIDXL_ModifierCelluleRT(ndn_Enfant, p_nden) Wend
Case DOMNODETYPE_TEXT_NODE: Set ndtn = p_Node
If ndtn.NodeValue <> "" Then
v_Couleur = gl_ParamCellules.Couleur(Trim(Cstr(ndtn.NodeValue))) If v_Couleur <> "" Then If p_nden.NodeName = "tablecell" Then 'Si l'attribut "bgcolor " n'existe pas, le créer et maj Call p_nden.SetAttribute("bgcolor", v_Couleur) End If End If
v_NouvValeur = gl_ParamCellules.NouvValeur(Trim(Cstr(ndtn.NodeValue))) If v_NouvValeur = "NULL" Then ndtn.NodeValue = "" End If
End If
NbrEnfants = ndtn.NumberOfChildNodes Set ndn_Enfant = ndtn.FirstChild While NbrEnfants > 0 Call SIDXL_ModifierCelluleRT(ndn_Enfant, p_nden) Set ndn_Enfant = ndn_Enfant.NextSibling NbrEnfants = NbrEnfants - 1 Wend
Case DOMNODETYPE_ELEMENT_NODE: Set nden = p_Node
' Modifier la police de la cellule If nden.NodeName = "font" Then
v_Police = gl_ParamCellules.Police(Trim(Cstr(nden.NodeValue))) If v_Police <> "" Then Call nden.SetAttribute("name", v_Police) Else Call nden.SetAttribute("name", g_PoliceDefaut) End If
v_TaillePolice = gl_ParamCellules.TaillePolice(Trim(Cstr(nden.NodeValue))) If v_TaillePolice <> "" Then Call nden.SetAttribute("size", v_TaillePolice) Else Call nden.SetAttribute("size", g_TaillePoliceDefaut) End If
v_CouleurPolice = gl_ParamCellules.CouleurPolice(Trim(Cstr(nden.NodeValue))) If v_CouleurPolice <> "" Then Call nden.SetAttribute("color", v_CouleurPolice) Else Call nden.SetAttribute("color", g_CouleurPoliceDefaut) End If
End If
NbrEnfants = nden.NumberOfChildNodes Set ndn_Enfant = nden.FirstChild While NbrEnfants > 0 Call SIDXL_ModifierCelluleRT(ndn_Enfant, p_nden) Set ndn_Enfant = ndn_Enfant.NextSibling NbrEnfants = NbrEnfants - 1 Wend End Select End If
Exit Sub GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIDXL, gc_Element_SIDXL, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
